hook: Counting severe drought raises the share of cactus species losing habitat from about 60% to about 70%

readout.label: Cases where drought models fit better

summary: Researchers added severe-drought data to distribution models for 993 cactus species using 648,316 occurrence records. Models with drought fit better in 91% of cases and projected more species losing suitable climate, especially with no dispersal. These are model projections of climate suitability, not observed extinctions.
title: Severe drought and warming increase the extinction risk of cacti.
